title: Heterozygous THBS2 pathogenic variant causes Ehlers-Danlos syndrome with prominent vascular features in humans and mice

reviewer.method: Entire 389-line main text read including Methods, Results, Discussion, all 44 references and endmatter; first 90 lines reread after a truncated combined tool output. All four main figures inspected as pixels; every page, panel and cell of all three one-page supplementary PDFs read as text and pixels. Figure3C QR-linked movie retrieved via exact author chain and all2213visualframes inspected in14contact sheets, plus8larger10fps sheets. Audio/continuous audiovisual playback not reviewed; movie and paper remain explicitly incomplete. All three patient packets and forty-four phenotype assertions individually compared.

audit.exposure_note: Post-inference review; aggregate benchmark outcomes seen but this case ranking not opened.

components.note: All2213visualframes reviewed in14contact sheets and full timeline rereviewed at10fps in8larger sheets. A mouse is lowered onto pellets; gloved hands bend/coil the tail, which remains looped during movement, then straighten it and release the animal. No labelled WT comparator, standardized force/angle measurement, blinded scoring or independent replicate series is displayed. This is a qualitative illustration, not a quantified genotype comparison. Audio and continuous audiovisual playback were not reviewed, so the component remains partial despite complete visual-frame coverage. Thumbnail inspection is not full-resolution kinematic analysis.

limitations: Three relatives share one variant-signature case ID; neither independent families nor three independent discoveries. Exact packet ages29/35/55 are more precise than source descriptions late20s/30s/50s.

access_issues.detail: Retrieval resolved and every visual frame reviewed; audio/continuous audiovisual inspection remains incomplete. This is a review-modality gap, not an access failure.

evidence.locator: H264/AAC source inspected through all-frame image representations

limitations: Post-inference source correspondence, not independent diagnostic validation.
Mouse bleeding assay is fourWT/fourmutants from two litters; three mutant times are right-censored at12min. No exact uncensored mean or precise effect-size CI can be recovered.
Main text says WT bleeding under4min but range200–240s includes exactly4min; all-mutant >11min caption differs from one reported11min. Retained as boundary wording differences.
Main text cites supplement2 panel ordering inconsistent with the supplied graphic/legend; actual graphic assignments retained.
A somatic-mutation driver assertion in Discussion is stronger than the titles of references42–44 (expression/prognostic studies); those external studies have not been independently adjudicated here.
No new human folate intervention, protein-trimer assay or N1002K/BubR1/drug-rescue evidence is presented.
Underlying data are author-request only; no author contact performed.
QR movie is qualitative; thumbnail review of all visual frames is disclosed separately from unreviewed audio and continuous playback. No additional case-level causal confidence follows.
